asked.item: Why Hermes loads github tools but no Blotato tools
What to change in config.yaml (two mcp_servers keys)

verdict.reason: The Hermes section says a second mcp_servers key makes the file invalid, so Hermes keeps the previous configuration without Blotato, and it says to add only the blotato entry under the existing key.

steps.text: A second mcp_servers key makes the file invalid, and Hermes keeps loading the previous configuration without Blotato.
If mcp_servers is already in the file, add only the blotato entry under it.
